method_note: Per market family, a monotonic (isotonic) curve maps the model's predicted probability to the realized hit rate, learned from settled outcomes. Bucketed for well-sampled families (preserves ranking), a family-average Bayesian blend for mid-sample, identity below that. ECE = expected calibration error (lower = the displayed % is truer). This makes the model honest at the source; it does not create edge (that needs a market price).
